name: Shelob, Dread Weaver
oracle_text:
Whenever a nontoken creature an opponent controls dies, exile it.
{2}{B}, Put a creature card exiled with Shelob into its owner's graveyard: Put two +1/+1 counters on Shelob. Draw a card.
{X}{1}{B}: Put target creature card with mana value X exiled with Shelob onto the battlefield tapped under your control.
blocked_sentences: {2}{B}, Put a creature card exiled with Shelob into its owner's graveyard: Put two +1/+1 counters on Shelob. Draw a card.

needs.what: an activated-ability cost that puts a card matching a selector from among the cards exiled with (linked to) the source into its owner's graveyard -- here `{types: [Creature], zone: exile, exiled_with: self}` -- unpayable when no such card exists
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `process` cost is a bare integer (carddef reads `int(spec['process'])`): it takes any card an opponent owns from any exile, with no selector, so it cannot restrict to creature cards nor to cards exiled with this source. The `put_exiled_into_graveyard` op with an `exiled_with: self` selector would move the payment to resolution, letting the ability be activated (and draw a card) with nothing exiled, which the notes forbid
